protocol.description: Private extension advertised only by the Luna compositor. Standard xdg-shell forbids absolute toplevel placement; this interface restores SetWindowPos / GetWindowPos semantics for Luna-session clients (aplay, luna-ui) that already know they are talking to Luna.

interface.name: luna_wm_v1
interface.description: Global singleton. Clients bind it when present and use set_position / get_position against their own mapped xdg_toplevel wl_surfaces.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: place a toplevel at absolute screen coordinates

request.description: Move the content top-left of an xdg_toplevel surface to (x, y) in compositor output coordinates (origin top-left of the primary output). Non-toplevel surfaces are ignored. The compositor may clamp into the usable area (outside docks / panels).

request.name: get_position

description.summary: ask for the current absolute position

request.description: Request a position event for the given surface. The compositor replies with one position event on this luna_wm object.

request.name: start_move
request.description: Start a compositor-side move of the given xdg_toplevel, equivalent to xdg_toplevel.move. Must be issued in response to a pointer button press that is still held; the compositor uses its last button serial. Prefer this over streaming set_position during a titlebar drag.

request.name: show_window_menu

description.summary: ask the shell for a window menu

request.description: Equivalent to xdg_toplevel.show_window_menu for frameless Luna clients that cannot reach the xdg_toplevel object through GLFW. x and y are surface-local coordinates for menu placement.

event.name: position
event.description: Sent in response to get_position. Coordinates match set_position.
